title: NextRun
description: Instead of generating a new world each time, the mod restores a clean backup, ensuring consistent world layout and fast resets.
body:
**A hardcore roguelike reset system for Minecraft survival challenges.**

Turn Minecraft into a true roguelike experience.

When you die, your world is automatically reset by restoring a clean backup. The terrain, structures, and world layout remain familiar, but all progress is lost. Every run becomes a fresh attempt where knowledge of the world is your greatest advantage.

This mod is designed for short, challenging playthroughs and works especially well with difficult modpacks focused on survival, exploration, and progression.

## Features

* Automatic world reset on death
* World reset by restoring a clean backup
* Run statistics screen after each death
* Track your attempts and performance
* Perfect for hardcore and roguelike modpacks
* Lightweight and focused on replayability

## Intended Gameplay

Learn from every run. Explore faster. Make better decisions.

The world stays the same. Your progress does not.

How far can you get before your next death?

## Disclaimer

This mod is intended primarily for singleplayer gameplay. Bugs or unexpected behavior may occur.
